title: Afghan citizen pleads guilty to, sentenced for Visa fraud
summary: U.S. Attorney Michael DiGiacomo announced today that Dilbar Gul Dilbar a/k/a Dilbar Gul Taj Ali Khan, a citizen of Afghanistan, pleaded guilty before U.S. District Judge Frank P. Geraci, Jr. to Visa fraud. He was then sentenced to serve six months in prison.
